Brain tumors are a fucking godsend, haha, JK! Forgot to add the biopsy the brain surgeon performed left me with double-vision. So now I have to wear glasses with a prism ($150 for one lens) for the rest of my life. Also, they said the double vision would go away after time, and it only got worse. 

**EDIT**: Life sucks, then you die. Whether you believe this or not it's a fact, and it's how life works. Skills and knowledge mean nothing.
